title: Chapter 94: Parasite
content:
Chapter 94: Parasite

Wu Qing asked the Queen to hatch 100 parasites and sent them to the Zerg clone to conduct parasitism experiments on those evil god believers who closed their perceptions, kept praying to the evil god, and waited for death to come.

If the experiment is successful, these more than 50,000 evil god believers will become another important force in Wu Qing's hands.

With this parasitic method, he can rob some evil god believers to parasitize in the future, weakening the enemy while strengthening himself.

This is what Wu Qing likes to do most.

…

On the battlefield of the camp war, with the security guarantee of the Zerg, the battlefield cleaning work went very smoothly. If the battlefield is large, nearly one-third has been cleaned up.

A large amount of useful materials were sorted out and piled up together, and the various corpses of the evil god camp were thrown together randomly and burned with a fire.

The sacrificed personnel of our camp were all classified by race, and their personal belongings were not moved. At that time, the lords of various races would deal with them by themselves.

As soon as the sky brightened, the weirdness disappeared, and the safety of the battlefield was worry-free, and the Zerg army withdrew.

After a big battle and working all night, the armies of the Tengu clan also withdrew one after another and began to rest.

Without the interference of the weird, the Tengu clan can send a large number of ordinary people to clean up the battlefield. After a big battle, their army suffered heavy losses, but the number of ordinary people did not decrease, and they can still send a large number of civilians.

The high-ranking officials of the Tengu clan, who no longer pretended to be deaf and dumb, learned that the Zerg army helped to guard the battlefield all night last night and eliminated a large number of weird. Many people's mood suddenly became bad again.

"Are they deliberately embarrassing us?"

"Why do they need to intervene in our Tengu clan's affairs!"

"What a busybody! Greedy! They want to intervene in the interests of the battlefield!"

"If there were no elders to speak for them, I would have brought people to trouble them long ago! A newly born race is so high-profile and arrogant!"

"..."

The elder of the Tengu clan, Gou Hong, did not come, and many high-ranking officials of the Tengu clan began to clamor.

Gou Yin stood alone outside the circle, listening to everyone's shouting. He was a little confused. How did these people who shouted climb to their current high positions?

He couldn't help but think of what his elders said to him: "Some changes will happen in the clan. You go out to practice, listen more, watch more, talk less, and learn more from the people around you."

"Learn from these people? Learn how to fight for petty gains, shirk responsibility, exclude dissidents, and be arrogant?"

As a leader of the younger generation in the clan, Gou Yin wanted to make a career, but the many experiences in his practice made him feel confused.

...

Wu Qing's Zerg clone stood on the city wall for a night. Because it was a Zerg clone, it didn't need to rest at all.

Wu Qing's consciousness was invested in the clone, and he returned to the city with the Zerg troops returning from the battlefield.

After a night of fighting, the Zerg came to the place where food was stored in the city, and they had a big meal to quickly replenish the energy they had consumed.

They must always be prepared for war. The Tengu tribe behaved strangely and now their attitude is unclear. The Zerg must be prepared.

In addition, there are more than 100,000 evil god troops stationed in the bear goblin city near the alliance. They did not have time to participate in this decisive battle between the camps.

Wu Qing did not know whether the evil god camp had such garrison cities in the nearby areas. These were all potential threats to the Zerg.

Wu Qing left the more than 20,000 new puppies and 1,000 hydralisks in the Zerg territory. The troops here were enough and there was no need for more.

Wu Qing entered the city and came to the place where the evil god believers were imprisoned, accompanied by ten Zerg people. 100 small parasites like scarabs were sent here.

The densely packed evil god believers sat cross-legged on the ground, praying to the evil god with a pious look. They were all trapped in a closed spiritual space, unable to extricate themselves, and had no perception of the outside world.

From a medical point of view, these are all considered vegetative people.

Wu Qing said nothing. A host flew over, rolled up 100 parasites, and placed them on the heads of 100 evil god believers with its tentacles flying.

The parasites that came to the heads of the evil god believers were like a ball of liquid, which immediately penetrated into the heads of the evil god believers.

The queen began to control the parasites and conduct parasitic tests on the brains of the evil god believers.

The first evil god believer who started the test immediately had other expressions on his face. Various emotions such as pain, dementia, happiness, madness, and sadness were played on the faces of the evil god believers who were tested.

A few minutes later, the evil god believers who had switched expressions for many times finally returned to normal.

He opened his eyes, and his fanatical eyes that were unique to the evil god believers disappeared, and turned into a pair of calm and pure eyes.

"Master!"

He saw Wu Qing and came over to salute respectfully.

"How do you feel?"

Wu Qing asked.

"Return to the Lord! I feel good, as if I have been reborn!"

"Do you remember the past?"

"Yes, the past is too painful to look back on. I am now a member of the Zerg!"

"..."

Wu Qing communicated with the evil god believer who was parasitized by the Zerg and found that the evil god believer's memory was still there, and he remembered everything that happened, but his mind had completely changed and he regarded himself as a member of the Zerg.

The evil god they originally believed in fanatically is now just an insignificant term in their eyes.

The Zerg parasites have a great influence on them. Now they should be regarded as a new intelligent creature with a pseudo-independent personality, mainly composed of Zerg parasites and the original intelligent creatures.

This kind of intelligent creature, in essence, can already be regarded as Zerg.

Wu Qing thinks that calling this kind of intelligent creature, or Zerg, parasites is very appropriate.

This actual test was very successful and the effect was very ideal. After the first test, the Queen of Zerg, who had found a way, controlled the other 99 parasites and instantly transformed the evil god believers into Zerg parasites.

"Queen of Zerg, continue to hatch parasites and transform all the evil god believers here!"

"Let them rest for a while, and then you can start carrying supplies back!"

There are a large number of giant lizards for transportation in the city, plus the 50,000 Zerg parasites who are about to become their own people, which is just a ready-made transportation team.

The Zerg moved quickly, using more than 500 larvae and consuming resources to hatch more than 50,000 parasites, and sent them over quickly.

The hosts in the city went into battle collectively and quickly placed the parasites on the heads of the evil god believers.

Not long after, more than 50,000 parasites were born.

Wu Qing asked the Zerg to send them food. After the transformation of the parasites, the parasites already had some Zerg characteristics, their physical fitness increased greatly, and they could start working after eating and drinking enough without rest.

This is a group of natural good laborers.
